verdict.summary: The change correctly closes the no-default-features rustdoc coverage gap for sparq-server. The new CI step uses RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings with cargo doc --no-deps --no-default-features, so unresolved intra-doc links in the async-stack-less configuration become gating failures. Each edited documentation reference targets an item unavailable without the server feature and is appropriately converted from an intra-doc link to a code span; this preserves readable documentation without creating cfg-dependent rustdoc failures. The workflow syntax and command are consistent with the stated invariant, and no runtime behavior or public API is changed.
